title: 市场预期再加两次：他为何说一次就够，ING首席经济学家看通胀
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The ECB prepares to meet for its September rate decision tomorrow, with markets certain 100% at price right now that a quarter point hike is on the way at that decision tomorrow.
segments.zh: 欧洲央行明天将召开九月利率决策会议，市场目前百分之百确定将加息25个基点。

segments.en: Let's bring in Maryac Ablom right now, ING Group, Chief Economist and Head of Global Research.
segments.zh: 我们请来ING集团首席经济学家兼全球研究主管玛丽亚克·阿布洛姆。

segments.en: Maryac, good morning. Thank you for your time. So the conflict is now beyond six months.
segments.zh: 玛丽亚克，早上好。感谢你的时间。冲突已持续超过六个月。

segments.en: This seems to be, this friction seems to be the new normal. Will one hike from the ECB be enough to contain inflation coming down the pipeline? Well, that's not exactly what the market is expecting
segments.zh: 这种摩擦似乎成为新常态。欧洲央行一次加息能否足以抑制通胀？市场预期并非如此。

segments.en: right now, right? So the market seems to be expecting another two over the course of by the end of this year and then next year. We would say that if you look at the inflation picture at the moment,
segments.zh: 市场似乎预期今年年底前再加两次，明年还会继续。但看当前通胀情况，

segments.en: that's still pretty well behaved and also looking further ahead when we look at next year, we don't expect to see very high inflation. That's mostly because yes, energy prices are obviously higher
segments.zh: 通胀表现相当温和，展望明年，我们预计通胀不会很高，主要因为能源价格明显上涨，

segments.en: and that is coming through in headline inflation. But if you look at core inflation, surfaces, wages and so forth, we don't see that much inflationary pressure, which is why we believe that
segments.zh: 这反映在整体通胀中。但看核心通胀、工资等，我们并未看到太多通胀压力，因此我们认为

segments.en: one rate hike could be enough. And so the most important thing we'll be listening to tomorrow is, is there going to be any forward guidance when it comes to the outlook for the economy? Because
segments.zh: 一次加息可能就足够了。明天最需关注的是，央行是否会就经济前景给出前瞻指引，因为

segments.en: with the market pricing in those three hikes, it's actually quite easy to give the market the impression
segments.zh: 市场已消化三次加息预期，央行很容易给市场留下这种印象。
